package core

// PlantedRemoved is removed by the change.
func PlantedRemoved() int { return 1 }

// PlantedRenamedOld is renamed by the change.
func PlantedRenamedOld() int { return 2 }

// PlantedSignature gains a parameter in the change.
func PlantedSignature(a int) int { return a }

// PlantedDeprecated is kept as a deprecated alias in the change.
func PlantedDeprecated(a int) int { return a }

// PlantedType loses a method in the change.
type PlantedType struct{}

// Kept is kept.
func (PlantedType) Kept() int { return 1 }

// Dropped is removed.
func (PlantedType) Dropped() int { return 2 }

// PlantedValue changes its value in the change.
const PlantedValue = "1.0"

// PlantedRetyped gains a type in the change.
const PlantedRetyped = "x"

// PlantedConstToVar becomes a variable in the change.
const PlantedConstToVar = "y"
